# sfcompute_instance_template (Data Source)

Reads instance template from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/instance_templates/{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:instance_template:acme:prod:my-instance_template' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_init_user_data` (String) Base64-encoded [cloud-init user data](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/explanation/format/index.html).
- `cloud_init_user_data_used` (Boolean) Whether cloud-init user data is configured for this template.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `enable_public_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether instances started with this template get a public IPv4 address.
- `firewall` (String) Firewall applied to instances started with this template. Present exactly when `enable_public_ipv4` is true.
- `image` (Attributes) Machine image to use when starting instances with this template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image))
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a instance_template resource. Format: sfc:instance_template:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `tags` (Map of String) Metadata tags attached to this instance template. Instances launched from it don't inherit these tags.
- `workspace` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Accepts the canonical prefix below; additional legacy prefixes are aliased for read compatibility. Writes always emit the canonical form.
- `name` (String)
